en.hint.advanced: Jump host · Proxy command · Host key alias
en.hint.aiEndedTab: The content stays for now: switch away or hit “Dismiss” to close this tab
en.hint.allowProxyCommand: When on, a proxy command set on a connection-book entry runs on this machine, and its stdin/stdout become the SSH transport to the target (the same idea as OpenSSH’s ProxyCommand). This is the only switch in this plugin that turns a settings field into local command execution, so it is off by default: while off, a connection carrying a proxy command fails explicitly (it does not fall back to a direct connection). Importing ~/.ssh/config never fills one in.
en.hint.appliedOnSave: Written to the config with the card's “Save”
en.hint.assistEnabled: Off by default. When on, a chip appears in the corner of the terminal after a command exits non-zero; clicking it sends that command's output tail (colors and progress bars stripped, repeated lines collapsed, keys/tokens masked) together with the current screen to the model — never the scrollback. A suggested command is only ever typed into the prompt line, never submitted for you.
en.hint.assistFillNoEnter: Types it into the prompt line; never submits
en.hint.assistNoCommand: The model gave no directly-insertable command — use Copy and pick one yourself
en.hint.assistRoute: Empty follows the host default model
en.hint.credRefCandidates: Candidates = reference names already in the credential store + those in use by the local host book
en.hint.flowLocalToRemote: Traffic flow: local → SSH server side
en.hint.flowRemoteToLocal: Traffic flow: local ← SSH server side
en.hint.grace: Sessions are kept alive for reconnect after a page refresh or network hiccup and end on timeout; applies live on save
en.hint.hostKeyAlias: Empty = pin by host address; one alias shares a fingerprint record across addresses.
en.hint.hostKeyAliasFull: Empty = pin the fingerprint by host address. When one host is reached through different addresses (behind a bastion / via port forwarding), give them the same alias so they share one host-key record instead of reporting a fingerprint change on every switch; it only decides where the fingerprint is stored, never the connection address
en.hint.hostKeys: A host with several keys (e.g. rsa + ed25519) gets one fingerprint each and any match is accepted; a changed fingerprint rejects the connection (MITM protection) — delete that record once you are sure it is safe, then reconnect
en.hint.importSshConfig: Same names are skipped; written to the config on “Save”
en.hint.jumpInherit: Empty credentials reuse the target host’s auth method and keys.
en.hint.jumpInheritFull: Empty credentials reuse the target host’s auth method and keys. When the jump host itself is unreachable the error names it (it will not masquerade as a target timeout).
en.hint.knownHostsTruncated: ; note: known_hosts has more than 500 hosts — only the first 500 were imported
en.hint.localDialFixed: The local dial address is fixed to 127.0.0.1
en.hint.localListenFixed: The local listen address is fixed to 127.0.0.1 (not exposed to the LAN)
en.hint.maxSessions: New tabs beyond the limit are rejected; applies live on save
en.hint.noCredRefPassphrase: No other connection uses a credential reference yet — you can type env:NAME straight into the passphrase box
en.hint.noCredRefPassword: No other connection uses a credential reference yet — check “Store in the credential store on save” above to create one, or type env:NAME straight into the password box
en.hint.noCredRefPasswordApply: No other connection uses a credential reference yet — check “Store in the credential store on apply” above to create one, or type env:NAME straight into the password box
en.hint.openInSessionCwd: Open in the current session working directory
en.hint.persistence: When on, all new tabs (local / SSH host book / SSH connection dialog) are hosted by tmux by default and survive a host restart; tmux must be installed locally/remotely; the SSH dialog can opt out per connection; existing tabs are unaffected
en.hint.persistenceWindows: ; tmux is unavailable on Windows hosts, so local tabs still open but are not hosted
en.hint.proxyCommand: A command on this machine whose stdin/stdout become the SSH transport; a jump host wins if both are set.
en.hint.proxyCommandDisabled: ⚠ “Allow ProxyCommand” is off right now: this command will not run and the connection fails explicitly (it does not fall back to a direct connection). Turn it on in Plugin settings → Terminal panel.
en.hint.proxyCommandFull: A command run on this machine whose stdin/stdout become the SSH transport to the target (the same idea as OpenSSH’s ProxyCommand). Supports %h host, %p port, %r user, %n host and %% for a literal %; anything else is left as written. If a jump host is set too, the jump host wins (OpenSSH semantics). It needs the switch below, and importing ~/.ssh/config never fills it in.
en.hint.proxyCommandNotGranted: ⚠ Not granted by the host: clicking this switch starts a grant in place (the panel shows one command to run in a terminal on the host — no restart), or use the strictest route — export DSH_TTY_ALLOW_PROXY_COMMAND=1 in the environment that launched dsh and restart the host (setting it after launch does not count). The reason: cross-site pages and in-page scripts can both send loopback requests, so if the settings UI could raise it out of thin air this gate would be pointless. Turning it off always works.
en.hint.rememberCredential: When checked, “Save changes” or “Connect (and save)” writes the password into the official credential store and leaves only an env: reference in the field (the value lives in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml; it is not put into the environment and is not sent back to the browser; it does not protect against same-user processes or the agent). Unchecked keeps today's plaintext write into the settings file. If a key or the agent works, do not store a password.
en.hint.rememberCredentialApply: When checked, “Apply” writes the password into the official credential store and leaves only an env: reference in the field (the value lives in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml; it is not put into the environment and is not sent back to the browser; it does not protect against same-user processes or the agent). Unchecked keeps today's plaintext write into the settings file. If a key or the agent works, do not store a password.
en.hint.remoteHostTitle: Target host name or IP (reached from the SSH server side; 127.0.0.1 = the server itself)
en.hint.remoteListenHost: Server-side listen address (defaults to 127.0.0.1; leave empty to allow only the server itself)
en.hint.reopenAgentLocal: This session was opened by the AI and has ended: this opens a new local terminal, it does not reattach to the original one
en.hint.reopenWithSpec: Open a session again from the same spec (persistent tabs reattach to tmux, command tabs run again)
en.hint.sftpDual: Dual pane copies files between local and remote (recursive, overwriting same names); takes effect after reopening SFTP
en.hint.sftpLimits: Browser-side guard: a single file over the limit aborts the download/upload (for large files use dual-pane ⇨/⇦ direct transfer or scp/rsync in the terminal; they do not consume browser memory); the file count limit applies to one batch/drag upload; applies live on save
en.hint.shellCandidates: Pick an installed shell from the list ($SHELL first) or type any path; zsh / bash support shell integration
en.hint.shellCandidatesWindows: Windows host: candidates come from %COMSPEC% and the installed PowerShell (Windows PowerShell 5.1 / PowerShell 7), and you can type any path; the PowerShell family supports shell integration (OSC 133/7 injected by a `-File` stub), cmd has no command-boundary hooks and is unsupported
en.hint.shellIntegrationPowerShell: The PowerShell family is instrumented through a `-File` stub: cwd following, exit codes, tty_expect and the running state all work. Known limit: on PowerShell 7 the command output reaches ConPTY after the D mark, so `tty_capture{last}` may come back empty — use `tty_capture` to read the tail there (Windows PowerShell 5.1 is unaffected).
en.hint.shellIntegrationWindows: cmd has no command-boundary hooks, so nothing can be injected: switch “Shell path” to powershell.exe or pwsh.exe (both are in the candidate list) and then make sure this switch is on (an earlier Windows install may have stored it as off). Remote Linux / macOS hosts are unaffected.
en.hint.sidebarHostAlign: After a host layout change this entry can end up narrower or shorter than its neighbours; turning this on matches the host sidebar row geometry (2px side insets). Off by default — when off the plugin keeps its own sizing
en.hint.sshBook: Written to the config together with “Save”; passwords/passphrases support env:VAR references to avoid plaintext storage
en.hint.sshConnect: Fill in host, user, and authentication manually
en.hint.statsEnabled: Off by default: persistent sessions survive closing the whole page (recoverable after the keepalive window); when on, they end together with the tmux session once the page disconnects and the keepalive window expires — note that refreshing the page within the keepalive window is unaffected
en.hint.term: TUI programs depend on this value
en.hint.terminalAppearance: A block cursor sits best on line height 1: above 1 the cell grows and the cursor towers over the glyphs. Shape and blink are owned here: programs in the terminal (zsh’s zle, vi mode, …) reset them on every prompt, so they are re-asserted once each output batch is parsed — full-screen programs (vim / less / htop) are left alone, since they use the cursor meaningfully
en.hint.terminalFontFamily: Rendering only, never the PTY; empty = built-in JetBrains Mono → SF Mono → … . Each name is double-quoted automatically (a bad name only drops itself, the rest still fall back). Applies live on save and re-lays out open tabs
en.hint.tmuxHosted: Hosted by tmux · recoverable after a host restart
en.hint.tunnelAdd: Takes effect immediately; reconnects automatically after a drop; prefer local ports above 1024; remote hosts are reached from the SSH server side (127.0.0.1 = the server itself)
en.hint.tunnelBookEmpty: Pick which SSH connection this tunnel uses (host and credentials come from the host book)
en.hint.tunnelEditing: Editing “{name}” — changing the port/entry derives a new name by rule; takes effect immediately on save
en.hint.tunnelLocalSummary: Left: local listener (fixed 127.0.0.1) → Right: target reached from the SSH server side
en.hint.tunnelRemoteSummary: Left: SSH server-side listener → Right: local service being reached (fixed 127.0.0.1)
en.hint.tunnelViaBook: Connects via {book} — the tunnel's host and credentials come from that host book entry
en.hint.tunnelsCard: Add, remove, enable, or disable tunnels in the port-forwarding section of Settings → Plugins → Terminal panel
en.hint.tunnelsSettings: Configure in Settings → Plugins → Terminal panel

en.list.hiddenOnly: (only hidden files here — click “Hidden files” on the pane header to show them)
en.list.modelCatalogFailed: Candidates unavailable — the host may not have restarted, or serves no model catalog (type provider/model to enter one manually)

en.list.tabsAllVisible: No tabs are out of view

en.meta.probeTcpSkipped: Direct TCP check skipped (using the proxy command)
en.msg.hostEdited: Entry “{name}” updated — written to the config on “Save”
en.msg.hostKeyDeleted: Host key record deleted (the fingerprint is recorded again on the next connection)
en.msg.importOverflow: {count} entries beyond the import limit were not imported
en.msg.importedFingerprints: Imported fingerprints for {added} hosts (skipped {skipped} that already existed)
en.msg.importedHosts: Imported {added} (skipped {skipped} duplicates); written to the config on “Save”
en.msg.maxSessions: Session limit reached ({live} total / max {max}: {own} in this window{others}) — close unused windows or tabs, or raise “Concurrent session limit” in the settings card
en.msg.noImportableHosts: ~/.ssh/config has no concrete hosts to import
en.msg.noImportableKnownHosts: known_hosts has no concrete hosts to import
en.msg.noNewEntries: No new entries ({count} skipped as duplicates)
en.msg.passwordNotStored: For security, plaintext passwords/passphrases are not kept in browser storage, so this connection needs them again: re-enter them when reopening the tab, or switch the credential to an env: reference in the settings card (the value lives in the host credential store).
en.msg.proxyCommandSkipped: {count} entries only set a proxy command (ProxyCommand) and were not imported: {names} — a proxy command is local command execution, so importing never fills it in; add it by hand on the connection-book entry and turn on “Allow ProxyCommand”

zh.confirm.closeText: 关闭面板会一并结束这 {n} 个还开着的会话（面板里的标签会跟着关掉）。
zh.confirm.closeTextAgent: 关闭面板会一并结束这 {n} 个会话，其中 {agent} 个是 AI 开的（可能正在跑命令）。
zh.confirm.closeTitle: 结束 {n} 个会话并关闭面板？
zh.confirm.tabsHint: 已退出的标签只是只读保留，清掉它们不丢任何东西。
zh.confirm.tabsText: 这一下会结束 {n} 个还开着的会话，它们的标签也跟着关掉。
zh.confirm.tabsTextAgent: 这一下会结束 {n} 个会话，其中 {agent} 个是 AI 开的（可能正在跑命令）。
zh.confirm.tabsTitle: 结束 {n} 个会话并关掉这些标签？
zh.connDetail.clickHint: 点击查看连接详情（目标 / 跳板机 / 认证 / 持久化）
zh.connDetail.hint: 数据来自这条会话的连接规格；要改连接请到 设置 → 插件配置 → 终端面板
zh.connDetail.persistPlain: 请求了持久会话，但 tmux 不可用 — 当前为普通会话
zh.connDetail.persistTmux: tmux 已托管 — 断线 / 宿主重启后按名接回现场
zh.connDetail.title: 连接详情
zh.elev.copyManual: 当前环境拿不到剪贴板，请手动选中上面那条命令复制。
zh.elev.envHow: 在「启动 dsh 的那个环境」里 export {env}=1，然后重启宿主。注意：启动之后再设、或写进别的配置文件都不算授权——这道闸门防的就是「运行期能改的东西冒充授权」。
zh.elev.expired: 本次确认已过期，请重新生成。
zh.elev.lockedWhy: 本机任意进程都能发回环请求，所以「打开危险能力」这件事不能由这个页面自己说了算——必须在宿主的文件系统上确认一次。
zh.elev.otherWay: 另一种方式（最强，需要重启宿主）
zh.elev.revoked: 已撤销宿主授权（配置开关保持不变，重新授权后会立刻生效）。
zh.elev.step: 在宿主的终端里执行下一条命令，开关会自动解锁：
zh.elev.title: 就地授权（免重启）
zh.elev.viaEnv: 由启动环境变量授权；要撤销需在启动环境里去掉它并重启宿主。
zh.elev.waiting: 等待确认…执行完命令这里会自动变成已授权。
zh.error.bookNameTaken: 连接簿里已有同名条目: {name}
zh.error.copyFailed: 复制失败：当前环境不允许访问剪贴板（http 访问时请改用 localhost 或终端内快捷键）
zh.error.credClearUnavailable: 宿主未提供凭据服务（remote.credentials），无法清除
zh.error.credPlainIncomplete: 凭据服务不完整，只能明文保存
zh.error.credPlainUnavailable: 宿主未提供凭据服务（remote.credentials），只能明文保存
zh.error.credRefNeedsHost: 先填「主机」和「用户名」再存入——引用名由这两者派生
zh.error.credStoreUnavailable: 宿主未提供凭据服务（remote.credentials），无法存入
zh.error.downloadTooBig: 文件超过下载上限（{size}）：请用双栏 ⇦ 直传或终端 scp/rsync
zh.error.dropOnLocalPane: 拖到本机栏没有可执行的动作：本机文件要传到对面，请拖到右侧「远程」栏
zh.error.hostKeyDeleteFailed: 删除主机密钥记录失败
zh.error.invalidTaskState: 服务端返回了非法的任务状态
zh.error.noTaskId: 服务端未返回任务 id
zh.error.terminalNeedsHost: ttyTerminal.mount 需要 HTMLElement 作为挂载点
zh.error.transferDirsNotReady: 两侧目录尚未定位完成，等列表加载后再传输
zh.error.tunnelClash: 已存在同名隧道「{name}」——请先处理那条同名的。
zh.error.tunnelLocalRequired: 本地端口、远程主机、远程端口必填
zh.error.tunnelMissing: 隧道「{name}」已不存在（可能被另一个窗口删除）
zh.error.tunnelNameTaken: 已存在同名隧道「{name}」——同一「连接簿条目 + 方向 + 端口」只能有一条。改端口会得到新名字，或先删掉旧的那条。
zh.error.tunnelNoBook: 请先在连接簿里添加 SSH 条目
zh.error.tunnelRemotePortRequired: 远程监听端口与本地目标端口必填（1~65535）
zh.error.uploadCountExceeded: 文件数超过上限（{max}）：本次 {count} 个，请分批上传
zh.error.uploadTooBig: 文件超过上传上限（{size}）：{name}，请用双栏 ⇨ 直传或终端 scp/rsync
zh.error.uploadTotalTooBig: 文件总大小超过上传上限：请分批上传（或用双栏 ⇨ 直传）
zh.field.cwd: 兜底工作目录（客户端当前会话 cwd 优先）
zh.field.grace: 断线保活（秒，0 = 立即结束）
zh.field.jumpAuth: 跳板机认证方式（留空沿用目标）
zh.field.jumpHost: 跳板机（[用户@]主机[:端口]，留空 = 直连）
zh.field.jumpUsername: 跳板机用户名（留空沿用目标）
zh.field.proxyCommand: 代理命令（ProxyCommand，留空 = 不用）
zh.field.sftpLimits: SFTP 传输限制（0 = 不限）
zh.field.terminalAppearance: 字号 / 行高 / 光标形态
zh.field.terminalFontFamily: 终端字体栈（逗号分隔，排在内置等宽字体之前）
zh.hint.advanced: 跳板机 · 代理命令 · 主机密钥别名
zh.hint.aiEndedTab: 内容先留着：切走或点「收起」即关闭这个标签
zh.hint.allowProxyCommand: 打开后，连接簿条目里填的代理命令会在这台机器上执行，它的 stdin/stdout 当作到目标的 SSH 传输（等价于 OpenSSH 的 ProxyCommand）。这是本插件唯一「配置里写一行就在本机跑命令」的开关，所以默认关：关着时携带代理命令的连接会明确失败（不会退回直连）。~/.ssh/config 导入永不自动带入代理命令。
zh.hint.assistEnabled: 默认关。开启后，命令以非零状态结束时终端右下角会出现一枚徽标；点它才把那条命令的「输出尾部」（剥离颜色与进度条、折掉重复行、密钥/token 已遮盖）连同当前屏幕发给模型，不发 scrollback。模型给的命令只会「填入」命令行，永不替你回车。
zh.hint.assistFillNoEnter: 只写进命令行，不会替你回车
zh.hint.assistNoCommand: 模型没给出可直接填的命令 — 用「复制」自己挑
zh.hint.assistRoute: 留空跟随宿主默认模型
zh.hint.credRefCandidates: 候选 = 凭据存储里已有的引用名 + 本机连接簿里在用的引用名
zh.hint.flowLocalToRemote: 数据流向：本机 → SSH 服务器侧
zh.hint.flowRemoteToLocal: 数据流向：本机 ← SSH 服务器侧
zh.hint.grace: 刷新页面/网络抖动后会话保活等待重连，超时后结束；保存即热生效
zh.hint.hostKeyAlias: 留空 = 按主机地址；同一主机经多地址触达时填别名可共用指纹记录。
zh.hint.hostKeyAliasFull: 留空 = 按主机地址记住指纹。同一台主机经不同地址（跳板机后 / 端口转发）触达时，填同一个别名可让它们共用一条主机密钥记录，避免每次切换地址都报「指纹变更」；只影响指纹记在哪，不改连接地址
zh.hint.hostKeys: 一机多把钥匙（如 rsa + ed25519）各记一条指纹，任一匹配即放行；指纹变更时连接会被拒绝（防中间人），确认安全后删除对应记录即可重连
zh.hint.importSshConfig: 同名跳过；随「保存」写入配置
zh.hint.jumpInherit: 留空凭据 = 沿用目标那台主机的认证方式与钥匙。
zh.hint.jumpInheritFull: 留空凭据 = 沿用上面那台主机的认证方式与钥匙；跳板机连不上时错误文案会点名它（不会伪装成目标超时）。
zh.hint.knownHostsTruncated: ；注意：known_hosts 超过 500 条主机，本次仅导入前 500 条
zh.hint.localListenFixed: 本机监听地址固定 127.0.0.1（不暴露到局域网）
zh.hint.maxSessions: 超过上限的新标签会被拒绝；保存即热生效
zh.hint.noCredRefPassphrase: 还没有别的连接用过凭据引用 — 可在私钥口令框直接手输 env:NAME
zh.hint.noCredRefPassword: 还没有别的连接用过凭据引用 — 勾上面的「保存时存入凭据存储」新建一个，或直接在密码框手输 env:NAME
zh.hint.noCredRefPasswordApply: 还没有别的连接用过凭据引用 — 勾上面的「应用时存入凭据存储」新建一个，或直接在密码框手输 env:NAME
zh.hint.openInSessionCwd: 在当前会话工作目录打开
zh.hint.persistence: 开启后所有新标签（本地/SSH 连接簿/SSH 连接对话框）默认由 tmux 托管、可跨宿主重启恢复；需本机/远程安装 tmux；SSH 对话框可对单次连接取消勾选；已有标签不受影响
zh.hint.persistenceWindows: ；Windows 宿主上 tmux 不可用，本地标签会照常打开但不受托管
zh.hint.proxyCommand: 本机命令，stdin/stdout 即到目标的 SSH 传输；与跳板机同填时跳板机优先。
zh.hint.proxyCommandDisabled: ⚠ 当前「允许 ProxyCommand」未打开：这条命令不会执行，连接会明确失败（不会退回直连）。到 插件配置 → 终端面板 打开开关后生效。
zh.hint.proxyCommandFull: 本机执行的命令，它的 stdin/stdout 就是到目标的 SSH 传输（等价于 OpenSSH 的 ProxyCommand）。支持 %h 目标主机、%p 端口、%r 用户名、%n 主机、%% 字面 %；其余写法原样保留。与跳板机同时填时跳板机优先（OpenSSH 语义）。需要下面那个开关，~/.ssh/config 导入不会自动带入它。
zh.hint.proxyCommandNotGranted: ⚠ 这条能力未获宿主授权：点这个开关会就地发起一次授权（面板给一条在宿主终端执行的命令，免重启）；也可以走最严的那条——在「启动 dsh 的那个环境」里 export DSH_TTY_ALLOW_PROXY_COMMAND=1 后重启宿主（启动之后再设不算授权）。这样安排是因为跨站页面与页内脚本都能发回环请求——若配置界面能凭空提权，这道闸门等于没有；关掉它则随时可用。
zh.hint.rememberCredential: 勾选后，点「保存修改」或「连接（并保存）」时把密码写进官方凭据存储，字段里只留 env: 引用（值在 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml，不进环境、不回传浏览器；挡不住同用户进程与 agent）。不勾选则按现状明文写进设置文件。能用密钥 / agent 就别存密码。
zh.hint.rememberCredentialApply: 勾选后，点「应用」时把密码写进官方凭据存储，字段里只留 env: 引用（值在 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml，不进环境、不回传浏览器；挡不住同用户进程与 agent）。不勾选则按现状明文写进设置文件。能用密钥 / agent 就别存密码。
zh.hint.remoteHostTitle: 目标主机名或 IP（由 SSH 服务器侧访问；127.0.0.1 = 服务器自身）
zh.hint.remoteListenHost: 服务器侧监听地址（缺省 127.0.0.1；留空即只让服务器自己访问）
zh.hint.reopenAgentLocal: 这条会话是 AI 开的、已经结束：点了会新开一个本地终端，不会接回原来那条
zh.hint.reopenWithSpec: 按原规格重开一条会话（持久标签接回 tmux，命令标签重跑一次）
zh.hint.sftpDual: 双栏在本机与远程之间对拷文件（目录递归、同名覆盖）；重新打开 SFTP 后生效
zh.hint.sftpLimits: 浏览器侧保护：单个文件超过上限时中止下载/上传（大文件请用双栏 ⇨/⇦ 直传或终端 scp/rsync，不占浏览器内存）；文件数上限针对一次批量/拖拽上传；保存即热生效
zh.hint.shellCandidates: 可下拉选择本机已安装 shell（$SHELL 优先），也可直接输入任意路径；zsh / bash 支持 shell 集成
zh.hint.shellCandidatesWindows: Windows 宿主：候选来自 %COMSPEC% 与已安装的 PowerShell（Windows PowerShell 5.1 / PowerShell 7），也可直接输入任意路径；PowerShell 家族支持 shell 集成（`-File` 桩注入 OSC 133/7），cmd 没有命令边界钩子、不支持
zh.hint.shellIntegrationPowerShell: PowerShell 家族由 `-File` 桩注入：cwd 跟随、退出码、tty_expect 与「有没有命令在跑」都可用。已知限制：PowerShell 7 上命令输出在 ConPTY 里晚于 D 标记抵达，`tty_capture{last}` 可能取到空——那里请用 `tty_capture` 读尾部（Windows PowerShell 5.1 不受影响）。
zh.hint.shellIntegrationWindows: cmd 没有命令开始/结束钩子，无法注入：把「Shell 路径」换成 powershell.exe 或 pwsh.exe（下拉候选里有），再确认这个开关是勾上的（此前的 Windows 装机上它可能已被存成关）。远程 Linux / macOS 主机照旧支持。
zh.hint.sidebarHostAlign: 宿主换版式后本插件入口可能比邻居窄或矮；打开即按宿主侧栏行的几何对齐（宽度让出左右各 2px）。默认关，关着时完全用插件自带尺寸
zh.hint.sshBook: 随「保存」一并写入配置；密码/口令支持 env:VAR 引用，避免明文入库
zh.hint.sshConnect: 手动填写主机 / 用户 / 认证方式
zh.hint.statsEnabled: 默认关闭：整个页面关闭时持久会话留存（保活期后可再恢复）；开启则页面断开且保活期结束时连 tmux 会话一起结束——注意刷新页面在保活期内不受影响
zh.hint.terminalAppearance: 方块光标配行高 1 最贴字：大于 1 会把单元格撑高，光标看起来比字形高一截。形状与闪烁由这里说了算——终端里的程序（zsh 的 zle、vi 模式等）每画一次提示符都会自己设定，本插件在输出解析完后纠回；全屏程序（vim / less / htop）除外，那类程序对自己的光标有真实语义
zh.hint.terminalFontFamily: 只影响渲染，不碰 PTY；留空 = 内置 JetBrains Mono → SF Mono → …。每个名字会自动补双引号（写错一个名字只会让那个名字失效，后面的照常回退）。保存即热生效，已开的标签就地重排
zh.hint.tmuxHosted: tmux 托管 · 宿主重启后可恢复
zh.hint.tunnelAdd: 添加后立即生效；断线自动重连；本地端口建议 1024 以上；远程主机由 SSH 服务器侧访问（127.0.0.1 = 服务器自身）
zh.hint.tunnelBookEmpty: 选择这条隧道要走哪台 SSH 连接（主机与认证取自连接簿）
zh.hint.tunnelEditing: 正在编辑「{name}」——改端口/条目会按规则生成新名字；保存后立即生效
zh.hint.tunnelLocalSummary: 左：本机监听（固定 127.0.0.1）→ 右：由 SSH 服务器侧访问的目标
zh.hint.tunnelRemoteSummary: 左：SSH 服务器侧监听 → 右：本机被访问的服务（固定 127.0.0.1）
zh.hint.tunnelViaBook: 经 {book} 连接 — 隧道的主机与认证取自该连接簿条目
zh.hint.tunnelsCard: 增删/启停在 插件配置 → 终端面板 的端口转发区块维护
zh.hint.tunnelsSettings: 在 设置 → 插件 → 终端面板 里配置
zh.list.emptyHostKeys: 暂无记录 — 首次 SSH 连接成功后自动记录主机指纹
zh.list.emptySshBook: （空 — 在设置卡片或「SSH 连接…」里保存）
zh.list.emptySshHosts: 暂无条目 — 终端面板「+」→ SSH 连接… 勾选「保存到连接簿」即可添加
zh.list.emptyTunnels: 暂无隧道 — 把远程数据库/内部服务映射到本地端口
zh.list.hiddenOnly: （这里只有隐藏文件 — 点栏上的「隐藏文件」显示）
zh.list.modelCatalogFailed: 拿不到候选：宿主可能还没重启，或没有提供模型目录（手输请按 provider/model）
zh.list.moreMatches: 还有 {count} 个 — 继续输入筛选
zh.list.noActiveTunnels: 该连接暂无启用的隧道
zh.list.noShellCandidate: 没有匹配的候选 — 直接输入任意路径即可
zh.list.tabsAllVisible: 没有藏在视野外的标签
zh.list.truncated: …其余 {rest} 项未渲染（共 {total} 项）——用上方路径框跳转到子目录定位
zh.meta.probeTcpSkipped: 直连预检已跳过（走代理命令）
zh.msg.downloadResuming: 连接中断，从 {offset} 处续传 {name}…
zh.msg.hostEdited: 已修改条目「{name}」— 随「保存」写入配置
zh.msg.hostKeyDeleted: 已删除主机密钥记录（下次连接重新记录指纹）
zh.msg.importOverflow: 超过导入上限的 {count} 条未导入
zh.msg.importedFingerprints: 已导入 {added} 条主机的指纹（跳过 {skipped} 条已存在）
zh.msg.importedHosts: 已导入 {added} 条（同名跳过 {skipped} 条），随「保存」写入配置
zh.msg.maxSessions: 会话数已达上限（共 {live} 个 / 上限 {max}：本窗口 {own} 个{others}）——关闭不用的窗口/标签，或在设置卡片调大「并发会话上限」
zh.msg.noImportableHosts: ~/.ssh/config 里没有可导入的具体主机
zh.msg.noImportableKnownHosts: known_hosts 里没有可导入的具体主机
zh.msg.noNewEntries: 没有新条目（{count} 条同名跳过）
zh.msg.noNewFingerprints: 没有新指纹（{count} 条已存在）
zh.msg.passwordNotStored: 出于安全考虑，明文密码/口令不随浏览器存储保留，本次连接需要重新输入：重开标签时再填一次，或在设置卡片把凭据换成 env: 引用（值存宿主凭据存储）。
zh.msg.proxyCommandSkipped: {count} 条只配了代理命令（ProxyCommand）未导入：{names} —— 代理命令是「本机执行一条命令」那一档，导入不会自动带入；需要时在连接簿里手填并打开「允许 ProxyCommand」
zh.msg.proxySkipped: {count} 条用了跳板机但解析不出跳板机（别名缺失 / 别名自己还依赖跳板机）未导入：{names}
zh.msg.skippedNotConcrete: {count} 条不是具体主机（通配 / 无 User）
zh.msg.uploadCanceled: 已取消上传（已传 {done}/{total} 个）
zh.option.localForwardTitle: 本地转发 -L：本机监听，连到 SSH 服务器侧的目标
zh.option.persistOff: 关闭 — 会话随面板/宿主结束（默认）
zh.option.persistTmux: tmux — 新开的终端/SSH 标签默认持久化
zh.option.remoteForwardTitle: 远程转发 -R：SSH 服务器侧监听，拨回本机服务
zh.option.sftpDialog: 单窗体 — 远程目录 + 上传/下载/拖拽
zh.option.sftpDual: 双栏 — 左本机 / 右远程，选中直传
zh.panel.title: 终端
zh.placeholder.credRef: 或：选择凭据存储里的引用名
